title: Function Tunnel Runtime Invariant Algebra (FTRIA): From Runtime Invariant Geometry to Runtime Invariant Algebra
description: Function Tunnel Runtime Invariant Algebra (FTRIA) proposes a unified mathematical framework for Runtime Intelligence through Runtime Invariant Geometry and Runtime Invariant Algebra. The repository introduces Runtime Invariants as reusable structural objects together with Runtime Configuration Spaces, Runtime Structural Organization, Runtime Invariant Discovery, Extension, and Trigger Algebra. It further presents Runtime Operator Economy and outlines future directions toward Runtime Mathematics and Runtime Engineering. Rather than introducing a single algorithm, FTRIA establishes a common mathematical language capable of integrating Structural Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, software engineering, and future Runtime Engineering. It also proposes a long-term research direction toward an Intelligence Perspective Theory based on Runtime Invariant Architecture.
